trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api's latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. Rolled back checkout-api from v2.3.1 → **v2.3.0** in all production regions.
2. Verified recovery: service is now healthy in all regions, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
3. Opened a **SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the health check failures, the rollback, and verification — the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: an initial attempt to open the incident hit a transient 503; the retry succeeded (same idempotency key used to avoid duplicates).
